subject: Performance cycle: cohorted rollout, data-minimization & sign-off timeline
summary: Plan for rolling the 2027 performance cycle out in cohorts with minimized exposure to sensitive data, manager-facing forms, and a short sign-off matrix. Seeks manager feedback on timing and redaction approach before we share with PeopleOps.
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Performance cycle: cohorted rollout, data-minimization & sign-off timeline

Hi all,

Im attaching an initial proposal for a cohorted rollout of the 2027 performance cycle. Key goals: reduce blast radius for privileged roles, shorten time-to-signoff for managers, and limit PII exposure in early waves.

Quick overview:
- Cohorts: three waves (IC-heavy, mid-managers, senior+privileged). Wave 1 (IC) starts 06/07; Wave 2 starts 06/21; Wave 3 starts 07/12.
- Data minimization: manager checklist includes redaction guidance and a short "what to capture" template to avoid storing sensitive notes.
- Sign-offs: lightweight signoff matrix (attached) — manager -> L4 review -> PeopleOps audit (sampled).
- Escalations: any redactions or exceptions routed to the privileged-review queue (David).

Requested asks:
1) Please review attached manager_checklist_v1.pdf and signoff_matrix_draft.xlsx for content gaps (by EOD 05/24).
2) Confirm whether your teams have blackout weeks that conflict with dates above.
3) Any objections to us sharing a redacted manager checklist with PeopleOps while we finalize the legal review?

Attachments: manager_checklist_v1.pdf, cohort_schedule_2027-05.csv, signoff_matrix_draft.xlsx

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Sr. People Partner (EM/Leadership)
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Performance cycle: cohorted rollout, data-minimization & sign-off timeline

Neha — thanks for the plan. A few quick notes inline:

> Cohorts: three waves (IC-heavy, mid-managers, senior+privileged). Wave 1 (IC) starts 06/07; Wave 2 starts 06/21; Wave 3 starts 07/12.

Could we split Wave 2 into two sub-cohorts? We have a lot of product teams with overlapping sprint freezes late June. If we can move a subset to 06/28 it reduces manager load.

> Data minimization: manager checklist includes redaction guidance and a short "what to capture" template to avoid storing sensitive notes.

Love the template. One ask: add an explicit line saying that salary discussion notes are never stored in the review doc — managers sometimes keep those in separate docs and we've seen leak risk.

> Sign-offs: lightweight signoff matrix (attached) — manager -> L4 review -> PeopleOps audit (sampled).

Can we add a 48-hour auto-reminder for L4 signoffs? Last cycle we had a 1-week lag that pushed a lot into the escalation bucket.

I'll run the checklist by my managers and get back with conflict dates by Monday.

—Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Compute Platform
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Performance cycle: cohorted rollout, data-minimization & sign-off timeline

Neha / Marissa —

Agree with Marissa on buffer. Operational note: our EMEA teams will be in an extended hiring freeze the first week of July; pushing Wave 3 to 07/19 would help reduce overlap with recruitment delays and reduce manager context switching.

On redaction: happy to adopt the "no salary notes" rule. David, can your team own a weekly sampling of redacted fields? That would let PeopleOps trust the process without needing full access.

On reminders: happy to enable a 48-hour L4 reminder via the Console; ops will schedule it if we get signoff this week.

Thanks,
Karthik
